descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper feminine name (מִיכַל) meaning 'who is like God?' (short form), referring to the younger daughter of King Saul who became David's wife (1 Sam 14:49; 18:20,27-28; 19:11-17; 25:44; 2 Sam 3:13-14; 6:16,20-23; 1 Chr 15:29). Multilingual evidence is uniform across all 18 occurrences: eng 'Michal/Mikhal', spa 'Mikal/Mijal', arb 'مِيكَال', kor '미갈', swa 'Mikali', hin 'मीकल'. The conjunctive/prepositional forms 'and-Michal', 'and-to-Michal' (S111230) are grammatical inflections of the same proper noun as the standalone form (S111228), not distinct senses.
